fullContentHtml:
MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post. This recruitment was released for 1700 posts. Applications for the MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Recruitment 2026 has Started from 29 August 2026, & Candidate can apply till 12 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 August 2026
  • Last Date : 12 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 September 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 17September 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • OBC, SC, ST : Rs. 310/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 310/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges Extra : Rs. 60/- (Include)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

  • Download Notification
